build.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 CUDA_COMPUTE_CAP=120 cargo build --locked --release -p switchyard-engine --features cuda --bins

scope: local single GPU sequential execution through tmux0 pane%3; warm source files and CUDA driver cache; no network hydration
measurement_conditions: One model/GPU job at a time in existing tmux session 0.
F32 cache timing uses three samples, BF16 uses one; model loading excluded from offline timings.
Eight 80-token prompts share 64 leading token IDs and generate 16 tokens each; single uses the first row.
F32 reference gate uses six histories at lengths 8/32/96 and 52 teacher-forced positions per model.
HTTP BF16 receipts measure real streamed content and usage, with existing weights and warm driver cache; cloud hydration/allocation excluded.

focused_kernel_measurement.measurement_scope: Single sample of 100 warm invocations per case. Elapsed host time including GPU completion, tables, allocation and launch; excluding page creation, append, model projection and end-to-end serving. Dense reference uses same established Qwen score and unnormalized exponential semantics; no old KV concatenation cost included. GPU tests serialized, desktop remained running.
limitations: One row at 1024 tokens remains 1.36 times slower than dense attention. No claim of full model speedup yet.
Source PTX is compiled at build time but CUDA driver JIT must still be exercised by the platform bake.
focused_kernel_measurement.note: Earlier compute_80 measurement; exact original source hashes retained. Current compute_120 rerun below uses the integrated source and updated layout diagnostic.

limitations: BF16 chunked/cached prefill changes greedy choices; quality contract and concrete numerical attribution remain open.
Empty-cache single requests incur checkpoint/staging overhead.
Paged kernel batch-one context-1024 microbenchmark is slower than dense.
Page tensors are individually allocated; no preallocated slab allocator or continuous request admission.
Retained byte charging excludes bounded object metadata, active states and kernel scratch.
No new RunPod/R2 bake or scheduler fleet acceptance is claimed by this local receipt.
